prose: LayerFS pitches itself as the filesystem for AI coding agents, built on ephemeral computing: compute exists only while a command runs, each file tool call is one atomic store operation, and each Bash call mounts an ephemeral workspace that is committed afterwards, reflecting that agents spend roughly 80% of their time thinking and 10% in Bash. The fetched page returned only these fragments, so this summary is limited to them.
highlights: Filesystem designed for AI coding agents
Ephemeral model: compute exists only while a command runs
Atomic file ops; each Bash call mounts and commits an ephemeral workspace
Observation: agents spend ~80% thinking, ~10% in Bash
